01 — Profile

What I do

I'm a second-year mechatronics and robotics engineering student at the University of Sheffield, interested in control systems, electronics design, embedded systems, and mechatronics more broadly.

Most of my hands-on time goes into microcontroller-based hardware design, control system implementation, and embedded C .

Outside of coursework, I'm an avionics engineer on two student rocketry teams, and I use personal projects to go deeper on control theory than any single module does.

03 — Projects

Coursework & Personal Projects

A mix of solo projects done for the sake of learning control theory properly, and group assignments from the degree.

Ball & Beam PID Control System
JUN – AUG 2026
Individual project, built over summer break.
  • Designed and 3D-printed the pivot, beam, and linkages in Fusion 360 for precision and durability.
  • Added a noise filter to clean up inaccurate time-of-flight sensor readings.
  • Built a feedback control loop with a PID controller driving ball position via the servo angle.
  • Modelled the closed-loop system in Simulink and simulated it with a MATLAB script.
  • Ran a frequency response analysis to examine controller performance across frequencies.
  • Added control signal saturation to protect the servo's physical limits, then tuned for a stable response.

Quarter-Car Suspension Simulation
NOV – DEC 2025
Individual assignment — modelling, simulation, and analysis.
  • Wrote a MATLAB script for car-mode selection, Simulink execution, and plot generation.
  • Added bump stops to the Simulink model and examined their effect in cruise and sport mode.
  • Tuned spring and damping constants to hit under 72% overshoot and under 0.25 s settling time.
  • Simulated the full axle as an independent suspension system on a realistic road profile.
  • Ran RMSE and MAE calculations comparing traction and stability across modes.
